name: hud_ui_net_exit_exit_button_on_activate
description: HudUiNetExitPanel_ExitButton::OnActivate queues the leave-network app state.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x41be70 validates a single RecoilApp::QueueSwitchCurrentState call on g_RecoilApp with g_RecoilApp.m_leaveNetworkState and state parameter 0.

The native smoke patches RecoilApp::QueueSwitchCurrentState, calls HudUiNetExitPanel_ExitButton::OnActivate, and verifies exactly one queued switch to g_RecoilApp.m_leaveNetworkState_1d0.base with parameter 0.
